text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ

words.gloss_range: clause-linking conjunction that keeps the sea command inside the prior directed sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation, not as a detached notice. It scopes over the whole command to leave the sea in its state, so escape and sea-management remain two coordinated instructions in one staged movement. Its liaison into the following imperative lets the reader hear the command arriving already joined to what came before.

topics.headline: continuation into the sea-command clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sea instruction is joined to the prior command sequence rather than introduced as a separate report.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the opening span as a coordinated command clause, so the conjunction links the whole instruction rather than only the following verb.

topics.headline: joined sound carries the command forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening particle pull directly into the command and object, matching its clause-linking work.
topics.reason: The surface alignment preserves the prefixed particle as a separable clause-linking unit while recitation keeps it audibly continuous with the imperative.

words.gloss_range: imperative to leave or let remain, locally narrowed to preserving the sea in an open state rather than abandonment or departure
words.root_gloss_range: leaving, relinquishing, letting remain, leaving a trace or leaving something in a stated condition; the local frame selects letting the sea remain in its specified state

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the known sea as direct object of the command
open, calm, slack state in which the sea is left

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتْرُكِ}} ({{tr:utruki}}) is a command, but its commanded act is restraint. The verb takes the known sea as its object and the following state-word as the condition to be preserved, so the order is not for Moses to depart from the sea but to leave it open and undisturbed. The same singular addressee continues from the prior command, while the linked sound into the object makes the command feel incomplete until the sea is named. That makes non-closure the active strategic lever: the route remains exposed until the rationale of drowning is declared, and the boundary movement from night travel to sea-state management shows the timing of one plan. The command also stands against the earlier strike-opened sea scene (26:63) and is echoed by the same root in the aftermath inventory (44:25), where leaving shifts from controlled strategy to what the pursuers lose.

topics.headline: command governs object and state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command as targeted sea-state management, not as a vague order to leave.
topics.reason: The local verb is a second-person masculine singular imperative with an explicit direct object and a strongly licensed circumstantial state.

topics.headline: leaving as preserved openness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that apparent non-action becomes the means by which the pursuers are exposed.
topics.reason: V4 includes leaving something to remain and leaving a thing in a state, while local syntax selects preservation of the open sea-state rather than abandonment.

topics.headline: same singular addressee continues
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the command to the same singular messenger while hearing the verb tightly joined to its object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the imperative's implicit subject as the same commanded messenger, and the local form is distributionally marked as the direct command instance.

topics.headline: left-open sea contrasts with striking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from opening the sea by striking it (26:63) to preserving the already opened passage here.
topics.reason: The local verb is a leaving command, so the inter-ayah contrast can clarify sequence without replacing the selected sense.

topics.headline: leaving becomes aftermath language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same root move from a commanded preservation of the sea to the pursuers' abandoned possessions (44:25).
topics.reason: The forward echo is concrete and compatible with the local leaving-as-preserving sense.

topics.headline: movement gives way to sea management
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the night movement and the open-sea command as timed parts of one plan.
topics.reason: The command is coordinated with the prior movement instruction and remains inside the same directed speech.

words.gloss_range: the known sea as the direct object of the leaving command, locally functioning as an opened corridor and later drowning medium
words.root_gloss_range: sea or broad water, with accepted breadth and cleft-opening pressure; local grammar selects the known water-domain while the scene narrows it to an opened passage
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَحْرَ}} ({{tr:al-baḥra}}) is the known sea placed directly under the leaving command. The article and accusative object position make it the narrative water-domain already charged by rescue and pursuit, while its placement before the state-word lets that state belong to the sea itself. The root's breadth and cleft-opening pressure survives locally as corridor imagery: the sea is not just scenery, but a single opened mass that separates, admits, and then becomes the medium of drowning. Its heavier sound and smooth attachment to the command hold the object under the imperative before the lighter state-word opens out. That pressure is reinforced by sea-crossing and drowning scenes (2:50; 10:90), and by the remembered split-path scene (20:77).

topics.headline: known sea as command object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command targeting the already known sea itself, not an unnamed route or Moses' own departure.
topics.reason: The noun is a definite accusative direct object of the imperative, and the following state-word is strongly licensed as its state.

topics.headline: broad sea narrowed to corridor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sea as a widened and cleft passage while still reading the local noun as the known sea.
topics.reason: V4 supports water-domain, breadth, and cleft-opening branches; local grammar keeps the selected sense as the sea object while the surrounding state and drowning rationale narrow the image to an opened corridor.

topics.headline: sea becomes trap environment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object of restraint becoming the environment through which the army is exposed to drowning.
topics.reason: The local ayah places sea, army, and drowning in one clause sequence, while supplied pair data ties sea language to drowning and army-at-sea scenes.

topics.headline: remembered split-path scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recalls water becoming a route (20:77), so this ayah reads as the after-state of an opened passage rather than the first act of opening.
topics.reason: The concrete echo supports comparison with a split-path scene without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: weighted object before airy state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the heavy sea-object held tightly under the command before the lighter state-word arrives.
topics.reason: The sound rows reinforce, rather than alter, the syntactically forced verb-object relation.

words.gloss_range: accusative state or manner naming the sea's calm, open, slack condition, with result-state force constrained by the local circumstantial parse
words.root_gloss_range: quiet ease, openness or gap, gentle movement, and related place or continuity branches; local sea grammar selects calm open slackness
words.prose: {{ar:رَهْوًا}} ({{tr:rahwan}}) is the hinge word of the first clause. As an accusative state or manner, it says the sea is to be left in calm, slack openness and that the leaving itself is non-disruptive. The second-object or result-state pressure is best kept as a narrowed payoff: the command intends this open-still condition, while the local attachment evidence prefers a circumstantial state. Because the word is rare and physically concrete, the open interval becomes the mechanism of the ayah: what looks passable remains exposed long enough for the final drowning predicate. It also reframes the remembered route and strike-open scenes (20:77; 26:63): the issue now is not making an aperture but maintaining one. Its light, open sound delays closure before the heavier ending arrives.

topics.headline: state-word governs sea and leaving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command includes a precise open-still condition, not merely the act of leaving.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the word as the circumstantial state in which the sea is left, with manner force compatible with that local role.

topics.headline: result-state force kept within circumstantial grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the open stillness as the intended outcome of the command while not re-parsing the word as an independent second object.
topics.reason: The translation support specifically warns that target languages may need to mark the word as the state in which the sea is left rather than as a second object.

topics.headline: calm openness becomes dangerous exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the sea's calm openness as dangerous precisely because it remains passable.
topics.reason: V4 supports quiet ease and open-gap branches, and local sea context selects their fused open-still force.

topics.headline: rare wording concentrates the interval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader dwells on this exact open-still state because the form is not a routine recurring label.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the local form as count one, so the surrounding command, sea object, and drowning rationale define its force.

topics.headline: open state bridges command and rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the state-word as the bridge between leaving the sea open and the army's drowning.
topics.reason: The word closes the command beat immediately before the explanatory clause, making the open condition the hinge into the rationale.

topics.headline: light opening delays heavy closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an airy, open pause before the later heavy drowning close.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows add an audible payoff that reinforces the semantic movement from exposure to engulfment.

topics.headline: motion and striking yield to stillness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earlier movement and opening give way here to a maintained aperture (20:77; 26:63).
topics.reason: The inter-ayah references serve as contrast and memory of the opened route while the local word names the maintained state.

words.gloss_range: assertive explanatory particle plus third-person plural pronoun, making the pursuers the subject of the rationale clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:innahum}}) turns the second half of the ayah into an asserted rationale. The particle does not begin a detached prediction; it explains why the sea is to remain open, matching the prior explanatory assertion across 44:23-44:24. The attached plural pronoun fixes Pharaoh's people as the clause's subject before the predicates reclassify them as an army already bound to drowning. The shift from the pursued addressees of the prior command to this third-person group separates the rescued community from the force that follows them. The doubled opening pressure and nasal thread carry that assertion into the predicate chain as one bound status unit.

topics.headline: assertion explains the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the army clause as the reason for leaving the sea open, not as a separate later report.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the clause as an explanatory assertion linked to the sea command.

topics.headline: pursuers fixed as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the plural pronoun as Pharaoh's people, not the rescued servants.
topics.reason: The attachment cross-reference resolves the suffix to Pharaoh's people and warns that translation may need to preserve that referent.

topics.headline: nominal clause makes fate a status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears drowning introduced as classification inside an asserted nominal clause before it is narrated as an event.
topics.reason: The particle governs a nominal predicate sequence, so the following army and drowning terms classify the referent.

topics.headline: nasal pressure binds the rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rationale open with pressure and then remain acoustically bound through the predicate chain.
topics.reason: The sound rows reinforce the asserted clause without changing its grammar.

topics.headline: paired rationale clauses bracket the commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two explanatory assertion clauses framing the movement command and the sea-state command across 44:23-44:24.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence identifies matched explanatory clauses across the adjacent command sequence.

words.gloss_range: indefinite collective army or host predicate, classifying the pursuers by organized military function before their passive fate
words.root_gloss_range: gathered force, troops, helpers, supporters, and grouped classes; local grammar selects the military collective branch, not place-name or rough-ground branches

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: plural passive drowned status qualifying the army

words.prose: {{ar:جُندٌۭ}} ({{tr:jundun}}) classifies the pronoun's referent as an army before the final qualifier names its fate. The indefinite collective singular reduces imperial identity to military function: they are not introduced by name or lineage, but by organized coercive force. That force is immediately made unstable, because the following plural passive participle fractures the one host into many recipients of drowning. The sea, army, and drowning field also recalls army-at-sea pressure (10:90), while the contrast with host-language elsewhere (33:9) sharpens this as a visible force emptied of effectiveness. The nasal cadence binds the army label to its passive fate, and the second rationale answers the prior pursued-status rationale by making military content collapse into exposure.

topics.headline: indefinite army predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pursuers classified by organized military function rather than by personal or imperial identity.
topics.reason: The noun is the indefinite nominative predicate under the assertion particle, and V4 supports the gathered-force branch as the local sense.

topics.headline: one host becomes many affected members
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a singular collective army being redistributed into plural drowned recipients.
topics.reason: The following sound masculine plural participle qualifies the collective noun, creating a local form contrast.

topics.headline: organized force recast as patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the strongest social form of the pursuers granted and then immediately overridden by passive drowning.
topics.reason: The predicate sequence places the military label before the passive qualifier, making reclassification a structural effect.

topics.headline: army inside the sea-drowning field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the army through the environment that defeats it, not as an isolated military label.
topics.reason: The supplied cooccurrence surface links army language with sea and drowning scenes, and this ayah compresses those terms into one local clause.

topics.headline: visible army contrasted with other hosts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears host-language resonate with 33:9 while seeing this visible force rendered helpless rather than supportive.
topics.reason: The concrete reference functions as contrast without altering the local military collective sense.

topics.headline: nasal cadence binds army to fate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the army label and drowning status as one compact asserted judgment.
topics.reason: The sound rows reinforce the predicate chain's cohesion without changing its syntax.

topics.headline: second rationale supplies military content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second rationale answer the prior pursued-status rationale with a military group already collapsing into exposure.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence pairs the rationale clauses, and this noun supplies the military content of the second one.

words.gloss_range: Form IV passive participle marking the army as caused-to-drown, distributed across its members and presented as settled status
words.root_gloss_range: drowning, sinking, caused drowning, saturation, total engulfment, and metaphorical overwhelm; local form selects caused submersion in water as passive status

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: collective army predicate qualified by the participle

words.prose: {{ar:مُّغْرَقُونَ}} ({{tr:mughraqūn}}) is the ayah's closing status-word. As a Form IV passive participle, it presents the army as caused-to-drown recipients while leaving the agent implicit; the result, not the event-process, dominates. Its plural form distributes the fate across the members of the collective army, and its position in the nominal assertion makes drowning an already assigned identity. The sea medium keeps the root's total engulfment physical rather than abstract, while Pharaoh's drowning scene (10:90) and later no-reprieve statement (44:29) show this closing word outrunning and sealing the visible sequence. Across the boundary, the prior pursued status (44:23) is answered by this drowned status. Its compressed onset, heavy root texture, and plural ending make that final passive status sound like closure after the earlier open sea-state.

topics.headline: Form IV passive status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the army is presented as caused-to-drown recipients, not as actors in a drowning event.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a Form IV passive participle qualifying the army, and V4 supports caused drowning within the root's accepted water-drowning branch.

topics.headline: plural fate breaks the collective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the one army redistributed into many affected beings under one fate.
topics.reason: The sound masculine plural participle qualifies a collective army noun, making agreement carry a distributive payoff.

topics.headline: drowning is environmental engulfment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the fate as total sea-bound engulfment, not merely military defeat.
topics.reason: The local sea context selects the water-drowning branch and keeps broader overwhelm imagery tied to physical submersion.

topics.headline: final predicate seals identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end by identifying the pursuers through drowning status before the event is narrated.
topics.reason: The word completes the nominal assertion and occupies the final position of the ayah.

topics.headline: military agency overwritten
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees armyhood itself become the site of passive vulnerability.
topics.reason: The participle immediately qualifies the army predicate, and supplied pair data links army language to drowning.

topics.headline: declared drowning outruns narration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the army's drowned status declared here before Pharaoh's drowning scene is narrated elsewhere (10:90) and before no reprieve is stated later (44:29).
topics.reason: Concrete cross-references support the status-field contrast without replacing the local passive participle.

topics.headline: status form chosen over common event narration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the passive participle as a marked status label rather than a routine drowning verb.
topics.reason: The occurrence profile marks passive participles as constrained beside more common event verb narration.

topics.headline: drowned status answers pursued status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the prior pursued status of the rescued group (44:23) answered by the pursuers' drowned status in 44:24.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence pairs the prior passive participial vulnerability with the current passive participial fate.

topics.headline: heavy sound closes the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word as a compressed and heavy closure after the open sea-state.
topics.reason: The sound rows preserve an audible payoff in the final participle without changing the grammatical analysis.

topics.headline: morphology syntax sound and boundary converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as a convergence point where form, position, recurrence, and boundary structure make drowning a settled status.
topics.reason: The local grammar, final position, supplied sea-drowning pair, and constrained passive-participle recurrence all point to status rather than simple event narration.

variants.scope_en: This branch covers another or later item after the first, including plural others and the farthest or absent latter one when explicitly stated.

baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative can preserve rather than terminate a sea-state: a wide cleft remains an open passage long enough for a mutually supporting force to enter the very medium designated to drown it.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing in a state makes the imperative preserve an operative condition rather than merely depart.
The wide-cleft image lets the sea itself be construed as a cut-open route.
An open gap or passage specifies the state that is to be maintained.
A gathered force of mutual helpers identifies the collective drawn into the maintained route.
Caused drowning supplies the corridor's lethal endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Move on and leave the sea behind in an unspecified condition.
changed_reading.after: Keep the sea's cut-open corridor operative; the pursuing formation's entry into that preserved opening is part of how its drowning is completed.

baseline_models.mechanism: A coexisting reading takes ترك as relinquishment and رهو as calm but continuous ease: the command withdraws human handling and releases the sea to resume or continue its own gentle motion. Stillness here is poised agency, not inert freezing.

activation_trace.role: Letting a thing go shifts agency away from the addressee and back to the sea.
Wide abundant water supplies the released physical medium.
Quiet ease marks non-agitated motion rather than a violently manipulated surface.
Smooth continuous movement keeps calmness dynamically compatible with the sea's ensuing action.
Drowning is the result once the relinquished medium acts on the force.

changed_reading.before: Hold the sea motionless after crossing.
changed_reading.after: Cease managing the sea and leave it in unagitated, continuous motion, allowing the calm medium itself to finish the event.

baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah scales from an open expanse to a gathered formation and then to total occupation of its field. Drowning is not merely many individual deaths; the environment absorbs the army's whole operational space and defeats collectivity as such.

activation_trace.role: Expanse and breadth establish a field large enough to become the mechanism.
The open passage channels the force into that field.
The gathered force makes mutual organization, not only headcount, the object at risk.
Immersion that occupies an entire field turns drowning into comprehensive takeover of the formation's domain.

changed_reading.before: An army happens to drown in a body of water.
changed_reading.after: An open environmental field takes over the entire gathered formation, making its organization unable to preserve any member.

baseline_models.mechanism: The causal إن-clause and passive participial description present the endpoint as the force's current defining status. The imperative is therefore grounded in a settled future identity, not in a speculative possibility.

activation_trace.role: Leaving the sea in a specified state becomes action taken because the following status is already asserted.
The gathered force is classified as one unit under the asserted fate.
Killing by drowning gives concrete force to the passive designation as an assigned endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Leave the sea because the pursuers may drown there.
changed_reading.after: Leave it so because the pursuers are already spoken of as a force marked for drowning; the future result governs the present command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies fixation, differentiation, and exact governance, while the later appointed gathering supplies a terminal schedule. Together they strengthen the focus clause's proleptic grammar: the drowning is an allocated outcome being executed through a present command.

activation_trace.role: Killing by drowning is the concrete endpoint whose settled status needs explaining.
Fixation that entails judgment or decree supplies a registration model for the announced fate.
Distinguishing two things supplies allocation of unlike outcomes rather than random catastrophe.
Exact construction and secure ordering make the allocated outcome operative rather than loose prediction.
A fixed appointment extends the scene into a larger schedule of determined encounters.

structural_cues: The surah opens with determination and differentiation before narrating the sea command.
The focus rationale uses a nominal passive description rather than a conditional warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decree, distinction, exactness, appointment, and the passive status; I infer that these make the command an execution step. A live alternative is emphatic prediction without any registration metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The speaker confidently predicts a drowning caused by the sea.
changed_reading.after: The command stages a previously differentiated and timed endpoint: the force enters the sea already bearing its assigned status.

context_deltas.mechanism: Smoke rising as an environmental substance and a covering that envelops people activate the field-occupation branch of drowning. Judgment works by making the surrounding medium itself close over the target, first atmospheric in the context and aquatic in the focus.

activation_trace.role: The sea as expanse supplies the environmental field that can become active.
Total immersion and occupation of a field recasts drowning as engulfment by surroundings.
Rising smoke supplies another diffuse medium capable of filling an environment.
A covering that generally envelops supplies the closure relation between medium and people.

structural_cues: 44:10-11 makes an environmental medium cover people; 44:24 makes a water medium take a force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies smoke, general covering, sea-expanse, and total immersion; I infer a repeated environmental mode of judgment. The alternative is that smoke and sea are independent episodes sharing no designed mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The army is killed by a singular aquatic event.
changed_reading.after: The army's drowning is one instance of a broader pattern in which the environment becomes an encompassing agent of judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trial of Pharaoh's people, later rescue by separation, and a test that reveals condition activate the open corridor as an assay. One material opening discloses two relations: servants separate out alive while the pursuing collective exposes itself as drownable.

activation_trace.role: The open passage is the single material condition through which both groups are sorted.
The gathered force supplies the collective whose condition is exposed by entering.
Drowning supplies the negative result of the assay.
Testing metal or people supplies the assay mechanism applied to Pharaoh's people.
Rescue through separation supplies the contrasting positive result from the same episode.
A trial that reveals condition sharpens passage through the sign into disclosure rather than transport alone.

structural_cues: 44:17 names the trial before the sea sequence; 44:30 names one group's rescue after it.
The focus gives the other group's outcome in the same breath as the open passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trial, revealing test, open passage, rescue, and drowning; I infer that the one corridor functions as an assay separating relations. The alternative is that the trial names the whole mission without assigning the sea a testing function.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a neutral route used successively by two groups.
changed_reading.after: The opening is a material assay: identical access reveals one group as separable for rescue and the other as a gathered force ready for drowning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal to one side, night travel, and certain pursuit turn the preserved opening into a timed lure. The command does not merely describe what to do after escape; it withholds closure so that tracking and catching up carry the organized force into the exposure.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing in a state provides deliberate maintenance of the route.
The wide open passage is the affordance temporarily offered to the pursuers.
Moving aside and withdrawing supplies the first tactical separation from the hostile group.
Night travel supplies concealment and temporal lead for the withdrawing group.
Catching up in pursuit supplies the pursuers' directed movement into the maintained gap.
Drowning is the terminal effect of allowing that pursuit to continue into the route.

structural_cues: 44:21 withdrawal, 44:23 night movement and pursuit, and 44:24 preservation form an ordered tactical sequence.
إنهم makes the force's drowning the stated reason for non-closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, head start, pursuit, maintained opening, and drowning; I infer that delayed closure is a lure. The live alternative is simple noninterference after escape, with no baiting function assigned to the opening.

changed_reading.before: Preserve the corridor as a static miraculous residue.
changed_reading.after: Preserve it for a controlled interval so the pursuers' own act of catching up carries their whole formation into the trap.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repetition of ترك followed by inheritance creates a causal chain of leave-behinds. Moses leaves the sea in an operative state; drowning makes the former occupants leave estates and cultivated abundance; those remains pass to others. The hydrological instruction begins a transfer of possession.

activation_trace.role: Leaving an effect to remain makes the sea-state the first consequential remainder.
Death by drowning supplies the transition that removes the former holders.
What the dead leave behind turns the repeated verb into an estate-like remainder.
Transfer from a predecessor to an inheritor supplies the destination of those leave-behinds.

structural_cues: 44:24 and 44:25 place two forms of ترك across the ayah boundary.
44:25-28 moves directly from abandoned abundance to its transfer to another people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two leave-events, drowning, abandoned goods, and inheritance; I infer a causal transfer from the first command through death to dispossession. The alternative is a narrative aftermath whose repetition does not modify the imperative itself.

changed_reading.before: The command concerns only the temporary condition of water during escape.
changed_reading.after: Leaving the sea operative initiates a larger regime of remains: the drowned leave their world behind, and occupancy passes to others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial that heaven and earth wept activates a restrained affective reading of the calm sea. A medium brimful with killing water does not convert that water into mourning tears; its quietness becomes impersonal completion rather than sympathy for the force.

activation_trace.role: Quiet ease gives the sea an affectively unagitated surface during the destruction.
Water filling land or eyes bridges the physical medium to the latent possibility of tears.
Grief expressed as tears and sound supplies exactly the response that the cosmic surroundings deny.

structural_cues: The drowning is followed by abandoned possessions and then the explicit statement that heaven and earth did not weep.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calm water, water filling eyes, and negated cosmic weeping; I infer that the sea's quietness participates in the denied lament. The live alternative is that 44:29 denies honor to the dead without characterizing the sea at all.

changed_reading.before: The sea is physically calm before or during the drowning.
changed_reading.after: Its calm can also be heard as affective non-lament: the water completes drowning but does not become tears for those erased.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rescue by separation is followed by characterization of Pharaoh as self-exalting and limit-crossing. Against that vertical claim, immersion supplies a material reversal: the elevated dominator and his force are taken below the surface while the separated servants come out.

activation_trace.role: Abundant water provides the vertical medium into which the claimed height is reversed.
Sinking to destruction supplies the downward term of the reversal.
Release through separation supplies the opposed trajectory of the rescued group.
Self-magnification and domination supply the social height that drowning overturns materially.
Crossing the limit makes overreach the motion that carries claimed elevation into submersion.

structural_cues: 44:30-31 juxtaposes rescue from the episode with Pharaoh's elevation and excess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation-rescue, drowning, elevation, and limit-crossing; I infer a vertical reversal from political height to physical sinking. The alternative keeps عاليا wholly moral and declines the spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: The sea destroys a pursuing ruler and army.
changed_reading.after: The drowning spatially answers their domineering elevation: overreach moves the self-raised force downward while the separated servants emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later gathering for separation and the failure of ally to aid ally disclose why the focus calls the targets a جند. Their defining strength is mutual assembly, yet the open field gathers them only so total immersion can abolish every relation of support.

activation_trace.role: A gathered force of helpers makes mutual support the formation's claimed protection.
Occupation of the whole field prevents collective organization from leaving an outside rescuer.
Separating things until their boundary appears supplies the unmaking of the gathered unit.
Joining dispersed members into one whole mirrors the army's assembled condition before separation.
Alliance and mutual aid name the social bond explicitly declared useless.
Help that makes another prevail supplies the capacity denied to every member of the gathered force.

structural_cues: 44:40 gathers everyone for separation; 44:41 immediately denies aid between allied persons.
The focus singularly predicates drowning of the collective جند.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a helping collective, total occupation, gathering, separation, and denied aid; I infer that the sea episode locally enacts the later unmaking of social protection. The alternative is a general eschatological parallel with no special force in جند.

changed_reading.before: جند merely reports that many soldiers drown together.
changed_reading.after: The word names the protection being defeated: the formation is gathered into one field where alliance cannot produce an outside helper.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence of seizure, forced dragging to the center, and pouring from above activates an inverted spatial choreography. In the focus an inviting center is left open and the targets move themselves into it before water encompasses them; later they are dragged to a center and punitive liquid is brought onto them.

activation_trace.role: The open passage supplies an accessible center entered without overt compulsion.
Total immersion supplies closure of the medium around those who entered.
Seizure and capture supply the explicit coercive analogue to the sea's eventual capture.
Violent dragging supplies directed movement of a target toward punishment.
A center or equitable middle supplies the destination of that directed movement.
Pouring a substance supplies the later liquid closure around the centered target.
The upper direction fixes the later medium's movement from above onto the captive.

structural_cues: 44:47-48 forms a verb sequence of take, drag, center, and pour.
The focus reverses the agency: pursuers enter the open center themselves before being encompassed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two center-and-liquid sequences; I infer that the later coercive choreography exposes the earlier sea event as a self-entered capture. The alternative treats the fire-punishment sequence as independent imagery rather than a reversal of the sea scene.

changed_reading.before: The sea episode is an isolated drowning miracle.
changed_reading.after: It is a reversed capture choreography: a center is made inviting, the force drags itself in, and the surrounding medium completes what later scenes do overtly by force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later rescue, secure dwelling, inward safety, and warding of harm separate visible calm from actual security. The sea's quiet openness is a shared affordance but not a shared refuge: it conducts the servants out while the pursuers mistake accessible calm for protection.

activation_trace.role: Open exposure makes the sea visibly accessible while withholding shelter.
Quiet ease supplies the appearance of safety that must be distinguished from actual security.
Rescue by separation assigns successful passage to the servants rather than to every entrant.
Dwelling in a place supplies stable residence as the positive spatial counterpart to exposed transit.
The heart's settled safety distinguishes true security from merely calm appearance.
Active warding of harm supplies the protection absent from the pursuers' easy access.

structural_cues: 44:30 assigns rescue to one group; 44:51-56 locates security in protected dwelling and warded harm.
The focus gives the other group the same open scene but the opposite endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quiet exposure, group-specific rescue, secure dwelling, and protection; I infer that the pursuers misread calm access as safety. The alternative is that رهوا describes only water-state and carries no deceptive affordance.

changed_reading.before: A calm open sea is itself a safe passage.
changed_reading.after: Calmness is only an affordance: for the separated servants it conducts toward safety, but for pursuers without protection it is exposed access to drowning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated commands to watch and the closing reciprocal watch activate ترك رهوا as disciplined temporal restraint. The sea-state is held through an interval while pursuit matures; afterwards no further delay is granted. Leaving is therefore timed non-action, not abandonment.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing in a state supplies maintenance during a bounded interval.
Quiet ease supplies the suspended, non-intervening posture of that interval.
Waiting and granting delay supplies the interval explicitly denied once the destruction is complete.
Watching and waiting at both ends of the closing sentence turns restrained expectation into a surah-level posture.

structural_cues: The focus and 44:59 share an imperative followed by إنهم and a plural participial predicate.
44:29 denies respite after the sea episode, marking a boundary between held-open interval and ended delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maintained calm, watching, reciprocal expectation, and denied respite; I infer that the sea is left open for exactly the pursuit interval. The alternative is that the final watch concerns only future judgment and does not reactivate the sea command.

changed_reading.before: Leave the sea and cease attending to it.
changed_reading.after: Hold it calmly under a posture of watchful non-action until pursuit reaches the appointed point; only then does the interval close.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates peripheral land and terrain branches across four focus roots. It remains valid as a focus-anchored material overlay in which every cited image participates, but downstream prose should mark it as topographic resonance rather than replace the ordinary sea, army, or drowning senses.

activation_trace.role: A pool or place left by receding flood turns leaving into a hydrological remainder.
Water-holding ground shifts the sea from object to terrain condition.
A hollow, pool, rise, or broad level land supplies the terrain's variable profile.
Rough stony ground lets the moving force be overlaid with the battlefield material it occupies.
Land saturated with water completes the conversion from corridor to inundated terrain.

changed_reading.before: Human actors move through a sea that later drowns an army.
changed_reading.after: The ayah briefly reads like a terrain transformation: a flood-left, water-holding corridor becomes saturated ground that absorbs the formation moving across it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-domain link between an easy sea-passage and an eased message is strange but branch-visible and anchored in رهوا. Preserve it as an analogy about facilitation, not an assertion that the sea literally signifies language or that ease causes belief.

activation_trace.role: Quiet ease makes passage physically unstrained.
An open passage gives that ease a concrete route.
Opening and ease after difficulty supplies the cross-domain analogue of facilitated access.
Conveying a message locates the later ease in communication rather than terrain.

changed_reading.before: Ease and openness are inherently favorable properties of the sea-route.
changed_reading.after: Ease is morally neutral access: the same open facility carries servants out and pursuers in, just as an accessible warning can be received without being followed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the rare unquenched-thirst branch of بحر against literal immersion and later punitive hot water. It remains anchored in the sea and drowning, but should be rendered only as an irony of liquid abundance, never as a claim that thirst is stated in the focus scene.

activation_trace.role: Severe thirst that water does not satisfy makes liquid abundance fail as relief.
Drowning supplies the extreme state of being surrounded by water that kills instead of relieving.
Hot water used punitively supplies a later instance of liquid functioning as anti-relief.

changed_reading.before: Abundant sea-water is dangerous only because it submerges the force.
changed_reading.after: Its abundance is also ironically anti-provision: the force is engulfed by more water than it could need, yet none of it can preserve or relieve.

strongest_changes: The preserved sea-gap became a timed lure whose openness lets pursuit perform the entry into drowning.
The passive status مغرقون became the execution of a differentiated, exact, and appointed endpoint rather than bare prediction.
The immediate repetition of ترك expanded the command into a chain from preserved sea-state to the dead's leave-behinds and inherited possession.
Calling the targets a جند became mechanistic: their mutual assembly is gathered into a field where no ally can aid another.
summary.what_was_special: Context did not settle رهوا into one safe gloss. It kept incompatible but functional readings alive: preserved opening, released calm motion, assay, deceptive ease, watched interval, and even non-lament. Repeated spatial and material patterns then made the sea episode both a local tactic and a prototype of wider judgment without erasing those alternatives.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether رهوا chiefly marks stillness, open breadth, or smooth continuing movement remains unresolved and productively changes the sea's agency.
The links to smoke-covering, later center-and-pour punishment, and final watching may be designed recurrences or reader-supplied analogies.
The terrain, unweeping-water, communicative-ease, and unquenchable-abundance readings are branch-anchored overlays, not secure lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Leave the passage in the state that enables the pursuers' entry.** `ت ر ك B003` supplies leaving a thing in a state, `ب ح ر B001/B002` wide water and expanse, `ر ه و B002` an open gap/passage, and `غ ر ق B002` killing by drowning. The command not to alter the sea is followed by the army's already-marked outcome; I infer that the open route is the enabling condition of their self-entry into the trap. The ayah reads still openness as active strategy.
2. **Quiet ease masks terminal immersion.** `ر ه و B001/B003` supplies quiet ease and smooth continuous movement, while `غ ر ق B001/B005` supplies sinking and immersion taking over a field. I infer that apparent ease of transit removes caution until water becomes total enclosure. This preserves a second material reading of `رهوًا` alongside “open passage.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:25-29 fills the retrospective consequence: the drowned force leaves gardens, springs, station, and ease, receives no cosmic mourning, and gets no respite. The open, quiet sea is thereby exposed as the hinge of a complete ownership reversal.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Leaving means preserving a designed state.** `ت ر ك` `B003` is leaving a thing in a specified condition; `ر ه و` `B001` is quiet ease and `B002` an open gap or sea-passage. The command does not abandon the sea indiscriminately: it preserves its calm opening while the following army enters. The packet supplies the imperative, state complement, pursuit, and drowning; I infer **maintained passage -> pursuers commit themselves to the route**. `ٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا` reads as controlled route geometry.

2. **The same opening is escape corridor and exposed encounter.** `ب ح ر` `B001` is wide water, `B003` a wide cleft, and `B005` open exposure without a screen. `ر ه و` `B003` adds smooth continuous movement. These branches assign the sea opposite roles according to sequence: smooth corridor for the commanded group, exposed field for the following army. The packet supplies both entrants and their outcomes; I infer **timing plus position -> one geometry produces opposed effects**. The sea is not a neutral backdrop but a selective spatial mechanism.

3. **Gathered force becomes total immersion.** `ج ن د` `B001` is a gathered force of helpers, while `غ ر ق` `B005` is immersion that takes over an entire field and `B001-B002` is drowning or killing by drowning. The army’s strength depends on concentration, but that same concentration places the whole force inside one water-field. The packet supplies gathered force and immersion; I infer **cohesive entry -> collective exposure to one enclosing medium**. `جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ` reverses military aggregation into the mechanism of defeat.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The gathering/separation day (`44:40`) and the two later destinations, the blaze’s center (`44:47`) and secure station (`44:51`), repeat this ayah’s selective geometry. The sea passage was therefore not an isolated marvel but an earlier model of one field producing opposite outcomes through authorized placement.

Hazırlanmış çerçeve bu ortak çekirdeği ve deniz, yaşayış, yürüyüş ile kişinin kendisine davranışı arasındaki bağlama bağlı görünümleri doğru biçimde yansıtır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, hareket ve çalkantıdan uzak dinginlik ile zorlamasız yumuşaklığı birlikte taşır.

Yaşayışa uygulandığında kaygısız, dingin ve kolay sürdürülen bir hayatı niteler.
Yürüyüşte veya bir işi yapmada sertleşmeden, telaşlanmadan ve ölçülü biçimde ilerlemeyi anlatır.
Kişinin kendisini gereksiz yere zorlamaması ve kendisine yumuşak davranması yönündeki öğütte kullanılır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, ortak bir bağ çevresinde toplanmış ve üyeleri birbirine destek olabilen bir topluluktur.

Aynı türden varlıkların ayrı bir sınıf halinde oluşturduğu topluluk da bu adla anılabilir.
Belirli kuruluşlarda söz, toplanıp düzenlenmiş bir topluluğu veya uyumlarına göre birleşen ve ayrışan can kümelerini niteler.

Borç, bela veya nimet içinde çıkışsız kalma, suyun altında kalmaya benzetilen bir kapsam genişlemesidir.
Boğulmak üzere olanın yakarışı, yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğinde çaresizce yardım dileme anlamı taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yayı veya oku çekişin ulaşabileceği son sınıra kadar götürmeyi ortak biçimde anlatır. Bir anlatım çekişin ok üzerindeki belirli bölüme kadar sürmesini ayrıntılandırır; bu ayrıntı, genel çekme ya da ok atma değil, yay çekişinin tamamlanma derecesidir.

concept_map.definition: Ok atmaya hazırlanırken yayı veya oku, yayın izin verdiği son çekiş sınırına kadar güçlü biçimde çekmektir. Belirleyici olan çekme eylemi değil, çekişin bütünüyle tamamlanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Yayı, çekilebileceği son sınıra kadar germek ve çekiş payının tamamını kullanmaktır.
Ok üzerindeki bağlama bölümünün yaya yaklaşmasına kadar süren şiddetli çekiş, işlemin teknik sınırını açıklar.
Yayı son sınırına kadar çekme görüntüsü, aşırılık ve ölçüyü kaçırma için atasözü niteliğinde de kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar okçunun yayı veya oku son çekiş noktasına kadar götürmesinde birleşir. Teknik ayrıntı, çekişin ok üzerindeki bağlama bölümüne kadar sürerek yayın bütün çekme payını tüketmesidir. Bu çekiş görüntüsü, aşırılık ve ölçüyü kaçırma için atasözü niteliğinde de kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir yalın anlamdan çok, yapıya bağlı iki düzen kurar: atın sürüye karıştıktan sonra onu geçmesi ve bir şeyin alanı bütünüyle kaplaması ya da tüketmesi. Nefes, bakış ve koşum takımı örnekleri ikinci düzenin farklı katılımcılar üzerindeki gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: At yarışı kullanımında karışma ve ardından geçme birlikte gerekir; öteki kullanımlarda ortak sınır bir alanı veya kapasiteyi bütünüyle kapsamaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, at yarışı yapısını kapsama bildiren biçim ve söz öbeklerinden ayırır; hiçbir özel kullanım yalın kökün tek anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda atın öteki atların arasına karışıp ardından hepsini geçmesi, başka kullanımlarda ise bir eylem veya nesnenin ilgili alanı ya da kapasiteyi bütünüyle kaplamasıdır. Nefesi sonuna kadar verme, bütün bakışları üzerinde toplama ve gövdenin koşum takımına sığmayacak ölçüde büyümesi bu ikinci düzenin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir alanın, sürenin veya kapasitenin hiçbir pay bırakmadan bütünüyle kapsanmasıdır.
At yarışında atın sürüye karışması ve bu karışmanın ardından öteki atları geçmesi iki aşamalı bir kullanımdır.
Nefes kullanımında soluk verme sürecinin bütün kapasitesi sonuna kadar kullanılır.
Bakış kullanımında bir kişi insanların dikkat alanını tümüyle kendisine bağlayıp başkasına pay bırakmaz.
Koşum kullanımında hayvanın yanları ve karnı, göğüs ve karın kayışlarının çevreleyebileceği alanı bütünüyle doldurur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar atın öteki atlara karışıp sonra onları geçmesini ayrı bir yarış yapısı olarak verir. Kapsama düzeninde ise soluk verme bütünüyle sürdürülür, bir kişi bütün bakışları kendine çeker veya iri gövde koşum kayışlarının alanını doldurup onları dar bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi süt veya başka bir içecekten alınan küçük miktarda birleşir. Miktarın kabın üçte biri, bir küçük kap dolusu, bundan daha azı veya bir içimlik olarak açıklanması kesin bir ölçü değil, küçük içecek payının kaynaklara göre değişen örnekleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın adın küçük süt veya içecek payı anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve başka dallardaki boğulma ya da yumurta anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Sütten veya başka bir içecekten, bir içimlik ya da küçük bir kap dolusu sayılabilecek az miktardır. Kaynaklardaki üçte bir kap, bir küçük kap veya daha azı açıklamaları yaklaşık miktar çeşitleridir.

facets.statement: Süt veya başka bir içecekten içmeye ayrılmış küçük bir miktardır.
Miktar bir içimlik, küçük bir kap dolusu, bundan daha azı veya kabın yaklaşık üçte biri olarak değişik biçimlerde açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sütü merkezde tutmakla birlikte başka içecekleri de kapsayan küçük bir içme payında birleşir. Verilen ölçüler bir içimlikten küçük bir kap dolusuna veya kabın yaklaşık üçte birine kadar değişir ve tek bir kesin hacim oluşturmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir gemin süsle kaplanmasını, özellikle de gümüşle bezeli olmasını anlatır. Belirleyici özellik yalnızca üzerinde tek bir süs bulunması değil, süslemenin geme yayılıp onu bütünüyle kaplamasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca gemi niteleyen söz öbeğinde, süsün veya gümüş bezemenin gemin tümüne yayılmasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım gemi niteleyen kalıba bağlıdır; genel süsleme, gümüş veya kaplama anlamı olarak yalınlaştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir gemin süslerle, özellikle gümüş bezemeyle, yüzeyi boyunca baştan başa kaplanmış olmasıdır. Tek bir süs parçası bulunması yeterli değildir; bezemenin geme yayılması gerekir.

facets.statement: Gem üzerindeki süsleme, yüzeyin bütününe yayılacak ölçüde kapsamlıdır.
Süslemenin gümüşle yapılması, kapsamlı bezemenin özellikle belirtilen bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli bir gemin süsle kaplanmasında birleşir; gümüş bezeme açıkça verilen özel malzemedir. Niteleme, süsün tek noktada bulunmasından çok gemin bütününe yayılmasını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca süslemenin gemin bütününe yayıldığı, gümüşün de kullanılabildiği niteleme için geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Gem nesnesini, süslemeyi ve bezemenin yüzey boyunca bütünüyle yayılması koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gemin bezemesinde kullanılan malzemenin özellikle gümüş olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gemi, gümüş bezeme ve bezemenin geniş yüzeye yayılması özelliklerini korur.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained.
